verdict.rationale: There is no documented sandbox or test-mode environment, such as separate test API keys or an isolated staging tenant. The closest evidence is Reducto Studio, where you build and test workflows on documents before deploying them as a callable Pipeline ID, which gives a draft-versus-deployed separation. The quickstart also uses a hosted sample document and the free tier includes usage credits, so you can experiment without production files. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment or test-mode keys isolated from production, documentation on separating test and production data, and independent corroboration.
